mapper.sql: id, notification_id, channel, recipient, status, retry_count, next_retry_at, failure_code, failure_reason, requested_at, sent_at, created_at
mapper.select: SELECT d.id AS deliveryId, d.status AS status, d.retry_count AS retryCount, n.id AS notificationId, n.receiver_id AS receiverId, n.notification_type AS notificationType, n.title AS title, n.content AS content, n.is_read AS `read`, n.target_url AS targetUrl, n.created_at AS createdAt FROM notification_deliveries d JOIN notifications n ON n.id = d.notification_id WHERE d.status IN ('REQUESTED', 'FAILED') AND d.retry_count < #{maxRetryCount} AND d.next_retry_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) ORDER BY d.id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE notification_deliveries SET status = #{status}, recipient = #{recipient}, sent_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6), next_retry_at = NULL, failure_code = NULL, failure_reason = NULL WHERE id = #{id} AND status = #{fromStatus}
